## How to Define a Function
- Use `def` and name the function followed by parenthesis.
- Specify formal parameters inside the parenthesis as a comma-delimited list

```python
>>> def square(x):
        return mul(x, x)
```

The line inside the function MUST be indented.

Having defined the `square` function, we can use it in a call expression:

```python
>>> square(21)
441
>>> square(add(2, 5))
49
>>> square(square(3))
81
```


Assignment statements and `def` statements assign bindings to names.

questions.query: How do list comprehensions filter a sequence?

evidence.text:
A *sequence* is an ordered collection of values. A sequence is not an instance of a particular built-in type in Python, but instead an abstraction: a collection of behaviors.

**Length.** A sequence has a finite length. An empty sequence has length 0.

**Item selection.** A sequence has an item corresponding to any non-negative integer index less than its length, starting at 0 for the first item.

While sequences are collections of items, which are values, each sequence itself is also a value.

Stellar Evolution
• The initial mass of a star 
determines its main-sequence 
lifetime and its evolutionary 
path
• Less massive stars have 
longer main-sequence 
lifetimes
• Sun-like stars end their lives 
as white dwarf stars
• More massive stars explode 
as supernovae and leave 
behind neutron stars or, for 
the most massive stars, black 
holes

evidence.text:
Earth Has Multiple Biomes
• Biome: geographical region with a characteristic climate and set of organisms
• Different approaches disagree on the number of biomes on Earth. 
• One set of biomes, as categorized by UC Berkeley’s Museum of Paleontology:
• Freshwater: <1% salt concentration; includes ponds, lakes, streams, rivers, & wetlands
• Marine: 75% of Earth’s surface; includes oceans, coral reefs, & estuaries
• Desert: can be hot or cold; 20% of Earth’s surface; rainfall < 50 cm/yr

questions.query: Which lecture page explains Eukaryotes Likely Evolved from Prokaryotes Symbiosis: when two organisms benefit from each other?

evidence.text:
Eukaryotes Likely Evolved from Prokaryotes
• Symbiosis: when two organisms benefit from each other
• Endosymbiosis: when two organisms benefit from each 
other and one lives inside the other 
• Science fiction example: the trill (Dax) living in host 
Jadzia on Star Trek Deep Space Nine (right)
• Real world example: microbes in the human gut
• Endosymbiosis is very important in the evolutionary history 
of eukaryotic cells
• Mitochondria are believed to have descended from 
endosymbiotic bacteria

• Each branching point represents a

questions.query: Which lecture page explains What is the biosphere? Catling defines the biosphere as “the sum of all living and dead organisms.”?

evidence.text:
What is the biosphere?
• Catling defines the biosphere as “the sum of all living and dead organisms.”
• Some definitions also include the environments in which life is found.
• How large is the biosphere of modern Earth?
• On land: 2×1015 kg of carbon (30-50% living)
• In the oceans: 1×1015 kg of carbon (0.1 – 0.2% living) 
• In the subsurface (underground): not sure, but could be significant 
• Estimates suggest 1% - 30% of Earth’s living biomass
